body: A tooltip on the export button is spelled wrong. Everything works and I only noticed because I was reading the screen closely.
The icon in the corner is a slightly different shade of grey since the update. No effect on anything I do.
The load spinner runs for about half a second longer than it used to. The page still opens and I have lost no time worth counting.
The help page lists the old menu names. I found what I wanted anyway. Might be worth updating some day.
An error box flashed up once yesterday and then went away on its own. I carried on and nothing else happened all day.
The column headings are not centred on the print out. It reads fine.
The date in the footer says last year. Purely cosmetic as far as I can tell.
Sorting by name puts the lowercase entries after the uppercase ones. I only have four entries so it makes no odds to me, but it looks odd.
The keyboard shortcut for save has stopped working. I use the menu instead, which is two extra clicks each time.
Saved filters do not stick between sessions any more. I set them up again each morning, which takes a minute.
The bulk edit screen fails on more than fifty rows. I split the work into batches of forty and it goes through. It adds maybe twenty minutes to a job I do weekly.
The search box misses partial words, so I have to type the whole term. Slightly slower but nothing is blocked.
Printing crashes the preview. I export to a file and print from there instead. It works every time and I have stopped using the preview.
The file picker opens in the wrong folder each time. I navigate across, which is irritating but quick.
Notifications arrive about an hour late. I check the page myself when I am waiting for something, so nothing has been missed.
Two of my six reports will not open in the browser. They open fine in the desktop client, which I have on the same machine.
The reconciliation screen times out about half the time. When it fails I have to start the whole run again, and some days it takes three attempts.
I can read records but I cannot edit them. Anything that needs a change has to be passed to a colleague on the other team, who does it for me.
The nightly import failed on Monday and Tuesday. We loaded Monday's file by hand on Wednesday morning. Tuesday's is still outstanding and the figures are wrong until it lands.
Attachments over two megabytes are rejected. Most of what I send is larger, so I am splitting documents into parts and sending several messages.
Only one of us can have the schedule open at a time. The second person gets locked out with no message. We have taken to shouting across the room before we open it.
Half the team cannot see the new queue. Those of us who can are covering the work, which is slow and means the others are idle.
Saving a long form loses everything below the fold. I now save every few fields, and I have lost an hour of typing twice this week.
The mobile app will not sync. Everything works at a desk. Half my day is on the road and that half is now written on paper and typed up in the evening.
Nobody in the office can raise a new order. Existing orders still open and we can dispatch what is already in the system, but nothing new can come in.
The pricing engine has been down since nine. We are quoting from last month's printed list, which is wrong for about a third of the range.
We can log in and the screens load, but every save fails with a server error. Reading works. As far as the day's work goes we are stopped.
Both warehouses have lost the picking screens. The pickers are working from printed sheets from yesterday, which are missing about two hundred lines.
The payment step fails for every customer using a card. Bank transfer still goes through, and about one order in ten is a transfer. The rest are simply not completing.
The main queue has been frozen since the early hours and is now eleven hours behind. Nothing has been lost yet but nothing is moving either.
Our largest site is completely off. The three small sites are unaffected and carrying what they can, which is under a tenth of normal volume.
Reporting is unavailable across the company and the month end is Friday. Day to day work continues, but nothing can be signed off.
Everything is down. No page loads for anybody, at any site, on any device. We have sent the floor home.
Total outage since six this morning. Every service, every office. There is no workaround and no partial service of any kind.
The system is up but every record we open shows another customer's details. We have stopped all work entirely until somebody tells us it is safe.
Nobody can log in anywhere. The sign in page itself will not load. All work has stopped across every team.
The database is refusing every connection and the standby will not come up either. Nothing can be read and nothing can be written. We are at a full stop.
Complete loss of service for all three hundred staff since midnight. No part of the platform responds.
Everything runs but every figure on every screen is wrong by an order of magnitude. We cannot trust a single number, so we have halted trading for the day.
The whole estate is offline. No email, no ordering, no telephones. We are turning customers away at the door.
